text.tspan: A money-transfer app adds one API call.
The family at home is guaranteed at
least ₱62.50 per dollar; if USD/PHP fixes
lower, the shortfall is paid automatically.
Pick a date, a place and a rainfall level.
agree it rained, it pays in full.
Lock dollars to mint guarantees, sell
them on an on-chain order book and earn
the premium. Your worst case is known
